title: Replication Data for: PACE-NL Programme for Optimal Palliative Care in Long-Term Care Facilities
descriptions: This dataset contains quantitative and qualitative data collected for the evaluation of the PACE-NL Programme, an adapted Dutch version of the PACE Steps to Success Programme aimed at improving palliative care in long-term care facilities. Data include questionnaire data from care staff, qualitative interviews with professionals and bereaved relatives, Mentimeter open-text responses collected during training sessions, attendance lists, and processed results from electronic health record documentation audits.
